## Libraries required
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```

## Read in data
```{r}
Coffee_shapefile <- read_sf("Data/Data Used in Analyses/CoffeeMap/data_0.shp")
Africa_shapefile <- read_sf("Data/Data Used in Analyses/AfricaMap/afr_g2014_2013_0.shp")
Banksia_shapefile <- read_sf("Data/Data Used in Analyses/BanksiaMap/data_0.shp")
Australia_shapefile <- read_sf("Data/Data Used in Analyses/AustraliaMap/coastline_250m.shp")
```

## Plot Africa

This map will go as an inset with a square to show the section of ethiopia zoomed in
```{r}
Africamap <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data= Africa_shapefile, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  theme_void()
Africamap

ggsave(plot= Africamap, filename = "Outputs/Africamap.jpeg",  device = "jpeg", width = 10, height = 10)
```


Plot coffea arabica's distribution


```{r}
coffeemap <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data= Africa_shapefile, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_sf(data= Coffee_shapefile, fill = "#E67F4B", color = "#E67F4B") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(31.5,43), ylim = c(3, 12)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 25)
coffeemap

ggsave(plot= coffeemap, filename = "Outputs/coffeemap.jpeg",  device = "jpeg", width = 10, height = 10)
```
## Plot Australia

This map will go as an inset with a square to show the section of SW WA shown
```{r}
Ausamap <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data= Australia_shapefile, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  theme_void()
Ausamap

ggsave(plot= Ausamap, filename = "Outputs/Australiaamap.jpeg",  device = "jpeg", width = 10, height = 10)
```

plot babksia ilicifolias's distribution


```{r}
banksiamap <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data= Australia_shapefile, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_sf(data = Banksia_shapefile, fill = "#E67F4B", color = "#E67F4B") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(114,125), ylim = c(-29, -36)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 25)
banksiamap

ggsave(plot= banksiamap, filename = "Outputs/banksiamap.jpeg",  device = "jpeg", width = 10, height = 8)
```
